name: Fortnite
antiCheat: Easy Anti-Cheat and BattlEye. Do not inject, hook or overlay the game process; Windows, driver and per-exe settings are fine.

configFiles.notes: FrameRateLimit, bShowGrass, rendering mode (DirectX 11/12/Performance) and resolution live here; the file can be rewritten by the game while it runs.

competitiveSettings: Performance rendering mode or DX12 with low settings on strong GPUs
frame cap a few FPS below a G-Sync/FreeSync limit, or uncapped with Reflex On + Boost
View distance medium or higher for visibility, shadows off
cloudSync: Most settings sync to the Epic account; a local edit can be overwritten at the next login.
benchmark: Replay mode: play the same replay segment with the same camera before and after.
typicalBound: Usually CPU-bound at high refresh rates in Performance mode; GPU-bound in DX12 with high settings.
caveats: Starting knowledge, not verified on this PC. Read the files with powershell-read before proposing writes.
